title: Two lanterns, nobody
logline: The Grunion Run with no festival and, this year, no man on the beach either: two lanterns far apart, the fish coming in, the pup sitting alone at the surf. Whose lantern the near one is, the page leaves.

panels.composition: A night beach with two lanterns far apart, the surf line silver with fish, and the pup sitting alone at the water's edge beside the near lantern, no one holding it.
